rollback_review: Before publication original Main and full immutable archive remain. Pending recovery promotes only exact already-written bytes with fresh predicates. After a possibly applied root or shared change, inspect the same operation and retain UNKNOWN; restoring an old path/profile is not safe rollback. A reverse change must be a new monotonic same-authority transaction, not an epoch/generation rewind. Destination collision, source/role/capability loss and native cuts have explicit negative assertions; no destructive cleanup or rollback performed.
privacy_review: Only public source/test paths, synthetic declarations, closed outcomes, counts and public run/commit IDs are recorded. Private topology, credential material and raw provider/OS output are absent. Fixed helper envelopes contain no arbitrary command, private path or executable payload. Public scan remains required in current immutable jobs.

It is not wired as a complete Qt reconfiguration screen. Canonical RP-053.C2 explicitly owns that GUI exposure and correlated feedback; RP-030 owns the later expanded interruption matrix. These are explicit later field/pilot limits, not fabricated passes.
